named_officer_data.bio_short: JNA officer leading the VRS main staff at the opening of the war.
named_officer_data.name: Ratko Mladić
named_officer_data.political_alignment_note: Modeled as an RS army-command appointment.

war_crimes_record.charges: Genocide, crimes against humanity, violations of laws of war
war_crimes_record.summary: Srebrenica genocide, Sarajevo siege campaign of terror, persecution and forcible transfer across Bosnia

named_officer_data.bio_short: JNA-trained commander assigned to 1st Krajina Corps in the opening OOB.
named_officer_data.name: Momir Talić

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (persecution), violations of laws of war
war_crimes_record.summary: Indicted for persecution of Bosniaks and Croats in Autonomous Region of Krajina; died of cancer during trial 2003

named_officer_data.bio_short: JNA-background officer assigned to 2nd Krajina Corps at scenario start.
named_officer_data.name: Radivoje Tomanić

named_officer_data.bio_short: JNA-trained commander assigned to East Bosnian Corps in the opening OOB.
named_officer_data.name: Novica Simić

named_officer_data.bio_short: JNA-background officer assigned to Sarajevo-Romanija Corps at scenario start.
named_officer_data.name: Tomislav Šipčić

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (murder, inhumane acts), terror against civilian population
war_crimes_record.summary: SRK commander convicted for prolonged sniping and shelling campaign against Sarajevo civilians

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (murder, inhumane acts), terror, unlawful attacks on civilians
war_crimes_record.summary: SRK commander convicted for continuing Sarajevo siege campaign including modified air bomb attacks

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (Srebrenica and Žepa, July 1995)
war_crimes_record.summary: Charged by the Court of BiH, not the ICTY, which recorded his command only in judgements against other men: the Krivaja-95 orders of 2 July 1995 that opened the attack on Srebrenica were issued in his name. He commanded the Drina Corps until about 2000 hours on 13 July 1995. The BiH indictment — crimes against humanity at Srebrenica and Žepa — is open and unanswered; Serbia separately tried him for war crimes against civilians and acquitted him in July 2025, upheld on appeal.

war_crimes_record.charges: Aiding and abetting genocide, crimes against humanity (persecution, murder)
war_crimes_record.summary: Drina Corps commander convicted for aiding Srebrenica genocide in July 1995

named_officer_data.bio_short: JNA-background officer assigned to Herzegovina Corps in the opening OOB.
named_officer_data.name: Radovan Grubač

war_crimes_record.charges: Genocide, conspiracy to commit genocide, crimes against humanity
war_crimes_record.summary: VRS intelligence chief convicted for role in Srebrenica genocide and forcible transfer of Zepa population

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (persecution, forcible transfer, murder)
war_crimes_record.summary: VRS Main Staff operations chief convicted for orchestrating forcible transfer from Srebrenica and Zepa

war_crimes_record.charges: Aiding and abetting murder and persecution
war_crimes_record.summary: Zvornik Brigade commander convicted re Srebrenica; lighter sentence for opening corridor allowing survivors to escape

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (persecution, inhumane acts), aiding forcible transfer
war_crimes_record.summary: Bratunac Brigade commander convicted for aiding forcible transfer of Srebrenica civilians

war_crimes_record.charges: Persecution as crime against humanity
war_crimes_record.summary: Zvornik Brigade deputy pleaded guilty for role in Srebrenica killings; cooperated with prosecution

named_officer_data.bio_short: JNA-background officer leading the RBiH army command at scenario start.
named_officer_data.name: Sefer Halilović
named_officer_data.political_alignment_note: Modeled as an RBiH army-command appointment.

war_crimes_record.charges: Violations of laws of war (command responsibility for Grabovica and Uzdol massacres)
war_crimes_record.summary: Acquitted of command responsibility for murder of Croat civilians during Operation Neretva 93

war_crimes_record.charges: Violations of laws of war (cruel treatment by mujahedin fighters)
war_crimes_record.summary: ARBiH commander convicted for failing to prevent abuse of Serb prisoners by El Mujahed Detachment

named_officer_data.bio_short: JNA-trained officer assigned to 1st Corps around Sarajevo at scenario start.
named_officer_data.name: Mustafa Hajrulahović "Talijan"

named_officer_data.bio_short: JNA-background officer assigned to 2nd Corps in the opening OOB.
named_officer_data.name: Željko Knez

war_crimes_record.charges: Violations of laws of war (command responsibility)
war_crimes_record.summary: 3rd Corps commander convicted for command responsibility for crimes against Croat civilians in central Bosnia 1993

war_crimes_record.charges: Violations of laws of war (murder, cruel treatment, wanton destruction)
war_crimes_record.summary: Indicted jointly with Hadzihasanovic; died before trial concluded 2003

war_crimes_record.charges: War crimes against prisoners of war
war_crimes_record.summary: 3rd Corps commander convicted for command responsibility re El Mujahed Detachment abuse of Serb POWs

named_officer_data.bio_short: JNA-background officer assigned to 5th Corps in the Bihac pocket.
named_officer_data.name: Ramiz Dreković

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (murder, persecution of Serb civilians)
war_crimes_record.summary: 5th Corps commander indicted 2018 for crimes against Serb civilians in Bihac area; trial ongoing

war_crimes_record.charges: Violations of laws of war (murder and cruel treatment of Serb prisoners)
war_crimes_record.summary: Srebrenica enclave commander; initial conviction overturned, fully acquitted on appeal 2008

named_officer_data.bio_short: JNA-background officer leading HVO army command at scenario start.
named_officer_data.name: Milivoj Petković
named_officer_data.political_alignment_note: Modeled as an HRHB army-command appointment.

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (persecution, murder, deportation), violations of laws of war
war_crimes_record.summary: HVO Main Staff chief convicted as part of Herceg-Bosna joint criminal enterprise to ethnically cleanse Bosniaks

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity, destruction of Stari Most (Old Bridge of Mostar)
war_crimes_record.summary: HVO commander convicted; died by suicide (poison) in ICTY courtroom as appeal verdict was read

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (persecution, murder, deportation), violations of laws of war
war_crimes_record.summary: HVO Main Staff chief convicted as part of Herceg-Bosna joint criminal enterprise to ethnically cleanse Bosniaks

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (persecution), violations of laws of war
war_crimes_record.summary: Central Bosnia OZ commander; initial 45-year sentence drastically reduced to 9 years on appeal

named_officer_data.bio_short: JNA-background officer assigned to Central Bosnia HVO command at scenario start.
named_officer_data.name: Tihomir Blaškić

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (persecution), violations of laws of war
war_crimes_record.summary: Central Bosnia OZ commander; initial 45-year sentence drastically reduced to 9 years on appeal

named_officer_data.bio_short: HV-background officer assigned to Tomislavgrad command in the opening OOB.
named_officer_data.name: Žarko Tole

war_crimes_record.summary: The ICTY named him in the Prlić et al. findings without charging him: as North-West Herzegovina OZ commander he ordered the arrest of all Muslim men of Prozor aged 16 to 60 on 6 July 1993, and reported the “cleansing” of four attacked villages at Gornji Vakuf that January.

named_officer_data.bio_short: Militia-origin commander assigned to Southeast Herzegovina in the opening OOB.
named_officer_data.name: Miljenko Lasić

named_officer_data.bio_short: Military-origin commander assigned to Northwest Bosnia in the opening OOB.
named_officer_data.name: Đuro Matuzović

war_crimes_record.charges: Grave breaches of Geneva Conventions, violations of laws of war
war_crimes_record.summary: Pleaded guilty for HVO attack on Bosniak village of Stupni Do; massacre of civilians October 1993

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (persecution, murder, deportation), unlawful attacks on civilians, wanton destruction
war_crimes_record.summary: Vice-president of Herceg-Bosna who exercised de facto military command in Lašva Valley; ordered Bušovača and Ahmići attacks

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against Serbian civilians in Orašje area 1992-1993
war_crimes_record.summary: Indicted 2016 for crimes against Serb civilians in Orašje; pleaded not guilty

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (persecution), violations of laws of war
war_crimes_record.summary: Viteska Brigade commander convicted for attacks on Bosniak civilians in Vitez; many convictions overturned on appeal

war_crimes_record.charges: Crimes against humanity (persecution, murder, rape), grave breaches of Geneva Conventions
war_crimes_record.summary: Convicts Battalion commander convicted for campaign of persecution against Bosniaks including forced labor and human shields
